subject.title: fix(telegram): Allow multi-agent ACP bindings within same account

question: Should Telegram support true multiple simultaneous ACP bindings for one account/topic, or only a same-account ownership handoff?
rationale: The PR description claims independent same-topic agent bindings, but the code and test implement last-writer-wins on the existing account/conversation key; choosing the permanent binding model is a maintainer product/API decision.

options.title: Define True Independent Bindings
options.body: Redesign storage and routing so multiple same-account ACP sessions can coexist for one topic with an explicit selection rule.

options.title: Accept Same-Account Handoff
options.body: Keep one binding per account/topic and update the PR, tests, and proof to describe an intentional ownership switch rather than independent sessions.

options.title: Keep Single-Owner Semantics
options.body: Reject the requested workflow for now and keep one active Telegram binding per topic until a broader routing design is sponsored.

recommendation.title: Define True Independent Bindings
recommendation.body: Redesign storage and routing so multiple same-account ACP sessions can coexist for one topic with an explicit selection rule.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses the current plugin-state storage contract and Telegram binding architecture introduced in the SQLite migration work.
